    • isFromEvaluator

      boolean isFromEvaluator(ProcessModelOperatingActionSetEvaluator evaluator)
      Checks runtime identity for a mutable-model handoff.

      The exact evaluator reference is deliberately transient. A deserialized result remains valid immutable evidence, but cannot authorize a new mutable envelope study without a fresh optimization and replay.

      Parameters:
      evaluator - candidate evaluator requesting the handoff
      Returns:
      true only for the exact evaluator instance that produced this result
